title_sq: Prane Mozaikut ,Shitet Apartament 1+1 I Sapo Investuar!
description_sq: Prane Mozaikut , Shitet Apartament 1+1 i Sapo Investuar!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5 te nje pallati ekzistues pa ashensor dhe ka siperfaqe neto te shrytezueshme rreth 44 m2. Apartamenti eshte i sapo investuar totalisht nga pronari duke filluar nga sistemi hidraulik, tualet inkaso, sistemi elektrik, dyer,parket, patinim, etj. Disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: Near the Mosaic, Newly Invested 1+1 Apartment for Sale!
description_en: Near the Mosaic, Newly Invested 1+1 Apartment for Sale!!! The apartment is located on the 5th floor of an existing building without an elevator and has a usable net area of ​​about 44 m2. The apartment is organized by the entrance corridor, the living room with the kitchen corner, a bedroom and a toilet, as well as the closed balcony with a large glass facade, which allows optimal lighting throughout the day. The apartment has just been fully invested by the owner, starting with the plumbing system, flush toilet, electrical system, doors, parquet, flooring, etc. The area offers many facilities starting from the perfect location and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment since the rents are very high in that area. It has full mortgage documentation.
